### 💡 Feature Proposal Summary

A clear and concise description of what the feature is and what problem it solves.

### 🎯 User Story / Use Case

As a **[role: e.g., Second Member / Fourth Member / Caretaker / Applicant]**, I want **[action / capability]** so that **[benefit / business outcome]**.

### 🛠️ Proposed Solution or Workflow

Describe how you envision the feature working within the application (e.g., new modal, extra export format, automated SMS reminder, dashboard widget).

### 🔄 Alternative Solutions Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### 📌 Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
